text: A program which is used to transform a source file into an executable binary file is called:
explanation_en: A compiler (also known as a translator) is designed to translate a program written in a high-level programming language (like C++) into a binary code deployed inside an executable file.

text: A process in which the source code is immediately executed without translating it into a machine code is called:
explanation_en: Interpretation (in the IT/programming sense) is a process in which the source code is executed on-the-fly, and this process is not accompanied by the creation of the machine code.

text: A code written in a high-level programming language is called:
explanation_en: A source code is a code written (usually by humans) in a programming language. This code needs either a compiler or an interpreter to be run.

text: A syntax is a part of a language definition which describes the rules used to build:

options.text: the sentences from a set of words.
the symbols from a set of dots.
the words from a set of symbols.

explanation_en: A syntax is a set of rules which must be obeyed to build grammatically correct (not necessarily meaningful) sentences in any language.

text: Arrange the arithmetic operations in the order which reflects their priorities, where the top-most position has the highest priority and the bottom-most position has the lowest priority. (Operations: EXPONENTATION, ADDITION, DIVISION.)
explanation_en: Python's arrangement of these three arithmetic operators is as follows: exponentiation (the power of) has the highest priority; multiplication and two kinds of division are in-betweens; addition along with subtraction take the lowest position.

text: Arrange the arithmetic operations in the order which reflects their priorities, where the top-most position has the highest priority and the bottom-most position has the lowest priority. (Operations: SUBTRACTION, EXPONENTATION, MULTIPLICATION.)
explanation_en: Python's arrangement of these three arithmetic operators is as follows: exponentiation (the power of) has the highest priority; multiplication and two kinds of division are in-betweens; addition along with subtraction take the lowest position.
